title: 4521-ESP-AGE-39-62-0002 Nitrogen Heaters (TES cold pump purge)
summary:
- The contract allows for alternate billing cycles.
- The project involves a new solar power generating plant near Gila Bend, Arizona.
- Vendor must provide nitrogen heaters for cold pump purge with continuous operation outdoors.
- Performance requirements are detailed in the vendor data sheets.
- Codes and standards from ASME, AWS, ANSI, ASTM, OSHA, NFPA, NEC, NEMA, SSPC, and UL must be followed.
- Six nitrogen electric heaters are required, each operating independently.
- Vendor must design and supply all aspects of the nitrogen heaters as per specifications.
- Heaters must handle nitrogen stream and maintain discharge temperature.
- Vendor is responsible for determining the optimum nitrogen heater size.
- Vendor's quotation includes startup and commissioning spare parts pricing.
- Maximum allowable pressure loss is specified, and vendor optimizes it.
- Materials of construction are specified on Data Sheets.
